verdict.rationale: Pipecat is a framework with a cloud platform, so publishing a machine-readable API spec is a fair question. The probe found no OpenAPI or Swagger document: every candidate path returned 404. The llms.txt file and the context-hub MCP index are docs and agent tooling, not a downloadable API specification, so they earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
